systems.country_label: birth notification; coverage of birth registration notification
systems.platform: DHIS2 (birth notification cards printed for it)
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, with UNICEF under the World Bank-financed HSTP
systems.tiers: health facilities; national coverage 2 to 2.5% at November 2025 against a 0.4% baseline and a 10% end target; a pilot in one state to be planned by 31 December 2025

note: A health project aide-memoire: it reports health-facility birth notification only, with no statement about registration by the civil registrar or about any civil registration system.
